Job Title:
SVP, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy

Location:
Canada – Remote or Mississauga, ON – Hybrid

Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles
: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles
: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

Position Summary

Reporting directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Senior Vice President, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy establishes and leads PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for Data as a Product. This executive leader is accountable for transforming PointClickCare’s unique data assets, ecosystem position, and network scale into differentiated products, strategic growth opportunities, and new sources of enterprise value.

The role owns the long-term strategy for customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace capabilities, data monetization, and data-enabled AI solutions while ensuring appropriate protection of intellectual property, privacy, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the senior Product Leadership Team, the SVP influences corporate strategy, investment priorities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives while leading a team of senior Product leaders responsible for PointClickCare’s data product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Define and lead PointClickCare’s enterprise Data Products strategy, including establishing a multi-year vision for Data as a Product that aligns with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and evolving market opportunities.
Identify, evaluate, and champion new business models and growth opportunities enabled by PointClickCare’s data assets, network scale, interoperability capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships.
Serve as the executive sponsor for customer-facing data strategy and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, Corporate Strategy, Legal, Go-to-Market, and the Corporate Data Office.
Own the strategy, roadmap, performance, and long-term success of PointClickCare’s data products portfolio, including customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability services, marketplace capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish investment priorities, resource allocation decisions, portfolio success measures, and business outcomes that balance customer value, market opportunity, and financial performance.
Drive adoption, customer value realization, commercial performance, and scalable product growth through strong portfolio management and strategic execution.
Lead PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for data monetization, marketplace growth, and ecosystem expansion.
Define customer access models, API strategies, pricing frameworks, packaging approaches, and commercial models that support sustainable growth while preserving trust and protecting intellectual property.
Identify new revenue opportunities, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem capabilities that strengthen PointClickCare’s competitive position and expand customer value.
Represent PointClickCare’s data strategy with executive stakeholders, customers, strategic partners, industry analysts, and industry organizations.
Lead executive-level discussions related to data products, healthcare interoperability, marketplace participation, data monetization, and AI-enabled customer solutions.
Build relationships that influence product direction, market positioning, and long-term growth opportunities across the healthcare technology landscape.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing product leadership organization through senior leaders, including VPs and Directors.
Establish succession planning, leadership development, talent strategies, and organizational capabilities that strengthen expertise in data products, APIs, ecosystem platforms, marketplace solutions, and monetization strategies.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management, technology, data products, platform strategy, enterprise software, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-level product, growth, or business strategies with measurable impact on organizational performance, customer outcomes, and financial results.
Proven experience leading large, complex product or technology organizations through multiple layers of leadership, including developing senior leaders and building organizational capability.
Track record of leading enterprise transformation initiatives requiring alignment across multiple functions, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.
Deep expertise in data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace and ecosystem strategies, data monetization models, AI-enabled products, and the business dynamics of data-driven organizations.
Strong strategic, financial, and operational acumen, including ownership of portfolio-level investment decisions, business cases, risk management, and performance outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, shape investment decisions, and represent organizational strategy with customers, partners, analysts, and other external stakeholders.
Experience leading marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or data monetization strategies is highly preferred.
Experience within healthcare technology, post-acute care, payer, provider, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
Experience engaging with industry analysts, strategic partners, customer advisory groups, or external industry bodies is preferred.
Ability to balance growth objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and intellectual property protection in a complex business environment.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...About Walmart Data Ventures

Walmart Data Ventures is dedicated to unlocking the power of Walmart’s data to drive smarter business decisions for Walmart and our partners. Through Scintilla, we bring together data, insights, and research capabilities to help clients better understand their customers and make more informed decisions.

About The Role

Walmart Data Ventures is looking for an experienced consumer insights, people and business leader to join our growing Research Services organization. The Director will lead a significant area of the business, with accountability for people, client experience, research excellence, capacity, commercial performance, and sustainable growth.

This is a leadership role focused on setting direction, developing talent, shaping commercial strategy, and strengthening how the organization operates as we scale. The Director is expected to lead beyond the boundaries of their immediate remit, identifying broader opportunities and challenges and driving solutions that strengthen Research Services as a whole.

The Director will serve as a senior research and business partner across Scintilla, translating business priorities into action, building strong cross-functional partnerships and ensuring our people, capabilities and ways of working are positioned to meet evolving client and commercial needs across DIY, flexible support and bespoke full-service Research Services. While this role is not primarily focused on individual project delivery, the Director will remain close to the work and provide senior-level consultation and leadership on strategic, complex or high-risk engagements.

What You'll Do...

Lead a significant area of the Research Services business, setting direction and making thoughtful tradeoffs across client needs, commercial opportunity, team capacity, research quality and talent.
Shape commercial strategy in partnership with commercial leaders across Sales and Account Management, identifying areas of greatest opportunity and translating them into clear priorities that drive sustainable growth, utilization and client value across Scintilla’s research capabilities.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of people leaders and researchers, creating clear accountability, strengthening leadership capability, managing performance, and building a strong pipeline of talent.
Operate with an enterprise mindset, looking beyond the immediate area of responsibility to identify opportunities, risks and ways of working that can strengthen Research Services and Scintilla more broadly.
Identify systemic challenges and proactively develop scalable solutions that improve how teams operate, collaborate and deliver, breaking down silos, and creating greater consistency and collective impact across the organization.
Lead talent and workforce planning, anticipating future capability and capacity needs and proactively shaping hiring, succession and organizational plans to support business growth.
Set and uphold a high bar for research excellence and client experience, serving as a senior research advisor on strategic, complex or high-risk engagements while empowering leaders and teams to own execution.
Build strong partnerships across Account Management, Product, Strategy and other Scintilla teams, representing the Research Services perspective and helping shape how clients move across DIY, flexible and full-service research models based on their needs and complexity.
Translate broader organizational and Scintilla priorities into clear direction for teams, creating alignment around what matters most and ensuring leaders understand both the “what” and the “why.”
Develop a strong understanding of the broader client and business landscape, identifying emerging needs, patterns and opportunities and using those perspectives to inform commercial priorities, capabilities and investment decisions.
Continuously assess how the organization should evolve as it scales, identifying opportunities to strengthen structure, capabilities, processes and ways of working across both self-service and expert-supported research.
Champion a one-team culture across Research Services, connecting people and ideas across areas, sharing knowledge and making decisions that optimize for the broader organization rather than any single team or portfolio.

Who You Are

You are an experienced consumer insights and business leader who can confidently move between research methodology, client needs, commercial strategy and organizational priorities.
You are a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams by developing talent, setting clear expectations and accountability, and providing thoughtful coaching, feedback and opportunities for growth.
You operate with an enterprise mindset, looking beyond your immediate responsibilities to identify opportunities and solve challenges that create value across the broader organization.
You are commercially minded and can translate market, client and business needs into clear priorities, thoughtful investments and sustainable growth opportunities.
You create clarity in ambiguous situations, anticipate what the business will need next and proactively mobilize people around solutions rather than waiting for challenges to become urgent.
You build trusted relationships and influence effectively across functions, recognizing that the strongest outcomes come from breaking down silos and operating as one team.
You are comfortable leading in a fast-growing, evolving environment where priorities can shift and leaders are expected to help shape how the organization works as it scales.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
15+ years of consumer or market research experience, including significant experience in client-facing roles.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and/or teams with multiple levels of responsibility.
Demonstrated experience leading a significant business, client portfolio, research function or other complex area of responsibility.
Deep expertise in quantitative and/or qualitative research, with the ability to provide senior-level guidance across research design, methodology, analysis, storytelling and client delivery.
Experience with workforce planning, talent development, performance management, and building organizational capability.
Strong track record of influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving outcomes across organizational boundaries.
Excellent bilingual (English and French) written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both senior executives and technical or research audiences.

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Our Technology Risk Services team is growing. We are looking for an executive director
to join our dynamic team in Montreal.

Our IT audit service lines include

Assisting KPMG Audit teams in both audit of technology and in leveraging technology in financial statement audits and integrated audits of financial statements and internal controls. Audit technology-related risks and controls and assist our Audit teams in addressing complex technology topics, including impacts of client artificial intelligence (AI) usage on the audits. Also, perform system implementation assessments in support of external audits at our clients.
Formal assurance on systems, processes, and controls, including Audits of Service Organization Controls (i.e., SOC 1 engagements under CSAE 3416, SSAE 18, and/or ISAE 3402), SOC 2 and SOC 3 engagements (systems security & reliability assurance), and other standards.

What You Will Do

Working closely with our Audit teams as the IT executive in charge for some client where permissible to scope processes, conducting assessments of IT risks and controls, including general IT controls and automated controls embedded within information systems in support of our external audit engagements.
Overseeing, conducting IT audit procedures (e.g., IT risk assessments, General IT Controls, IT Application Controls, large System Implementations and Data Conversions) in support of financial statement audits and internal controls over financial reporting.
Overseeing, conducting IT internal audit and third-party attestation engagements such as CSAE 3416 / SSAE 18 / SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports.
Overseeing the planning, managing, and completing IT Audit project tasks including liaising with client and KPMG teams; collecting, testing, and exploring information; documenting and evaluating IT processes, controls, policies, strategies; and performing detailed quality assurance review and feedback on the work of others.
Communicating (written and verbal) findings and recommendations to the client including technical and business communication to management through the preparation of reports and analyses; preparation of advisory and assurance reports and related deliverables.
Guiding field engagement teams as well as coaching junior staff members.
Influencing and contributing to other practice initiatives, including but not limited to knowledge sharing, training, HR initiatives, and practice management activities.
Supporting regulators file inspections process.
Supporting go-to-market initiatives for business development.

Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Business or Computer Science degree required, ideally with a major in accounting.
Completion of one or a combination of the following designations CA, CISA, CISSP.
Minimum of 10 years of combined relevant experience in IT Audit (internal and/or external audit) within a large consulting practice.

Experience with the identification and or evaluation of process level controls in large system transformation projects involving SAP and or Oracle.
Experience in the testing of controls in different IT environments, like SAP, Oracle, Unix, Linux, AS400, Mainframe, etc.
Experience within an external audit practice auditing client in the Financial Services, Technology and Telecom, and Mining industry.
Ability to work both, with little supervision and within a team environment.
Excellent communication skills being able to express insights, both written and orally.
Demonstrated ability to learn and succeed in a fast-paced environment.
Attention to detail and strong organization and investigative skills.
Strong understanding of business risks and audit risks.
Have a high degree of personal confidence, enthusiasm, and drive.

This position requires written and oral fluency in English because it involves interpretation and application of English standards, guidance, laws and regulations, servicing of English-speaking clients located across Canada and collaboration with English Speaking colleagues located outside of Quebec.

jobs.description:
You will set the technical program agenda across the closed block mainframe and policy administration domain, providing direction for how these critical platforms remain stable, reliable and cost-effective while progressively modernizing the in-force technology landscape. This role balances the operational responsibility of servicing in-force policies without interruption with the strategic mandate to reduce cost and risk and advance modernization over time.

You will lead multiple direct reports and the squads within their organizations, serving as a trusted technology partner to the AVP and business stakeholders. You will provide clear accountability and transparency related to cost, risk, progress and outcomes.

Position Responsibilities

Set the technical program direction for the mainframe and policy administration portfolio, defining priorities, sequencing, dependencies and delivery approaches across a multi-year sustainment and modernization agenda.
Lead multiple direct reports and their squads, with accountability for resourcing, performance, capability development, delivery effectiveness and consistent engineering standards across the portfolio.
Partner with Business Delivery Leads to prioritize investment and capacity, balancing platform stability and sustainment, regulatory and risk commitments, operational obligations, and incremental growth and modernization opportunities.
